services.desc: Exercise program geared toward mature adults. Charge is $4 per session, or a pass may be purchased at $20 for 6 classes. The classes are held at the Mariposa Park Amphitheater on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday from 8:30 - 9:30 a.m. Classes will begin October 5th, 2026. Call our office for more information or check us out on our Facebook page. This program is offered to the adult community for continuous swimming from one end of the pool to the other. Charge is $2 per session, or a 11-session pass may be purchased for $20. Lap Swim is offered during weekdays. Please note that pre-season there may be cancellations due to pool parties.
